Ohhhh, that's interesting. And he said that the
place in Watts was owned by George Brown. Who's George Brown?

Well, George Brown had a... He's all mixed up.
George Brown had a nightclub. I told you I played out there for Rudolph
Valentino. Well, you see, you couldn't buy liquor in Los Angeles but you
could buy it in Watts, so George Brown was a big politician--a fixer, you
know. Anything you got in jail or anything, he could fix it fer you. So
he had a little dump out there. All colored people went to it but...
but Jelly Roll might've played there, I don't know, but over where we
played was two blocks from there was…

But when Jelly Roll left the Cadillac and went
to Watts, he went to the Wayside Inn--he went to your place. Right?
